caption: Naomi Campbell as DJ in Munich, Germany.
Ninh Binh, Vietnam People use a boat to move through a flooded house after several days of rain.
Nagoya, Japan Thailand’s Jutatip Kuntatong kicks the ball during the women’s doubles teqball quarter-finals match against Myanmar at the Asian Games.
Tehran, Iran A man holding an Iranian flag peers through an opening in a curtain during the state-organised Janfada (Sacrifice for Iran) military-style parade.
Donetsk, Ukraine A voter casts her ballot during Russia’s parliamentary elections at a polling station in Russian-controlled Ukraine.
Yangon, Myanmar Novice Buddhist nuns carry alms bowls while collecting donations at a street market.

Ceuta, Spain People scuffle on Benítez Beach as they wait to be transferred to a newly built pavilion. Thousands remain in Ceuta after more than 70,000 migrants crossed into the Spanish enclave in north Africa enclave from Morocco in late July.

Pristina, Kosovo A Kosovo Albanian takes part in a protest called by war veterans after the former president Hashim Thaçi and other former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders were convicted of war crimes in The Hague. Thaçi was sentenced to 25 years in prison by a tribunal.

Jerusalem Worshippers taking part in Selihoth, a prayer in which Jews offer repentance and ask God to forgive their sins. The ritual precedes Yom Kippur, the day of atonement and the holiest day in the Jewish calendar, at the Western Wall.
Munich, Germany Naomi Campbell DJs during HeidiFest by Heidi Klum in the run-up to Oktoberfest at Hofbräuhaus.
Netanya, Israel Ultra-Orthodox Jewish men perform the Tashlich, a traditional atonement ritual.
London, UK A customer tests the iPhone 18 Pro at the Apple store in Regent Street. The handset was officially launched in the UK on Friday 18 September.

Gaza City Mira Hamdoona, a seven-year-old Palestinian, walks through streets destroyed by Israeli airstrikes on her way to a temporary school in al-Shati area. Despite severe hardships and limited resources caused by Israeli military operations, many children continue their education.

Cali, Colombia Firefighters and local people battle a fast-moving wildfire threatening homes in Altos de Menga. Fuelled by prolonged dry conditions, lack of rainfall and strong winds, the blaze tore through hillside vegetation, sending large plumes of smoke across the city.
Spielberg, Austria Italy’s Marco Bezzecchi of the Aprilia Racing team on the Red Bull Ring track for a practice session before the Austrian MotoGP.
Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine Smoke rises above a church in front of a burning shopping centre after a Russian drone strike.
Woman with long dark blond hair in the grounds of a stately red brick building wearing a dress and matching hat made of grains and flowers and holding a bunch of sunflowers.
Sali, Croatia Sailing boats at Telašćica nature park, on the edge of Dugi Otok island in the Adriatic Sea.
London, UK Models on the catwalk at the Paul Costelloe show at Banking Hall during London fashion week.
Frontignan, France French fishers burn tyres and block access to an oil depot near Sète during a protest over high energy prices and working conditions.
Hanoi, Vietnam People ride motorbikes along flooded streets after overnight torrential rain inundated homes and disrupted travel.

Odesa, Ukraine People inspect their damaged flat after a Russian drone hit their block amid a barrage of overnight strikes on targets across the country. The air assault came shortly after US lawmakers approved a sanctions bill targeting Moscow.
Sant Elm, Spain Lighting whips across the sky over the sleepy fishing village on the south-western tip of Mallorca.
Xiangyang, China The historic city in north-western Hubei province has been promoting tourism through light shows, evening cruises, live performances and night markets.
Santiago, Chile Chile’s president, José Antonio Kast, and the first lady, María Pía Adriasola, perform the country’s traditional cueca dance during Independence Day celebrations.
Nablus, West Bank A boy cycles near Israeli armoured-personnel carriers deployed during a military operation at the entrance of the al-Ain refugee camp.
Mexico City, Mexico Special forces troops march through Zócalo Plaza during the Independence Day military parade.
Shanghai, China The opening of the third Shanghai international light festival at Yanzhong Green Space in Huangpu District, which runs until 16 October.
Ripon, UK Anna Cartmell Done poses at an event marking the 50th anniversary of the Harrogate autumn flower show. The model is wearing a themed dress called Grain and Grandeur.
London, UK A rare 17th-century portrait of two unidentified teenage boys, one of whom is of African heritage, is installed at the National Portrait Gallery. The artist is unknown.
Chiba, Japan A cosplayer poses as a character from the open-world survival game Palworld during the Tokyo game show 2026 in Makuhari Messe, near Tokyo.
Nagoya, Japan Thailand fans pose in the stands before the female basketball team faces off against Indonesia during the Asian Games 2026 at Aichi International Arena.
Havana, Cuba A woman lit by a battery-powered lamp feeds a baby on the pavement outside her home during a power outage.
Doves sit in cages during an annual bird singing competition in Narathiwat, Thailand.
Frontignan, France Police clash with fishers during a blockade of an oil depot. French fishers are protesting against rising fuel costs and EU restrictions on the number of permitted fishing days.

Pristina, Kosovo Supporters of the former president Hashim Thaçi take to the streets in protest after the 58-year-old was found guilty of war crimes. Thaçi was sentenced at a hearing at The Hague to 25 years in prison for crimes committed during Kosovo’s independence war against Serbia in the 1990s.

Gaza City Rescue workers search for dozens of people trapped after a six-storey building housing about 100 displaced Palestinian people collapsed, killing at least 20 people. The building had previously been hit by Israeli strikes during the war, leaving its structure badly weakened and at risk of collapse.

Sana’a, Yemen Pickup trucks travel in a mass funeral procession for Houthi officers and other military personnel killed in fighting against Saudi-backed government forces. The conflict in Yemen has intensified in recent weeks, with the Houthi rebels now controlling the country’s west coast and launching strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure as well as shipping.

Kramatorsk, Ukraine A woman collects items from her home after it was destroyed during an airstrike while she was at a street market. A Russian drone strike on a bus near the frontline in southern Ukraine killed at least five people and injured seven others on Wednesday.

Ma’arrat al-Nu’man, Syria Displaced children pass a mountain of rubbish at a dump, where people scavenge for plastic and metal that can be sold for recycling. Approximately 5.5 million people remain internally displaced in Syria after years of conflict, according to the UN.

Durban, South Africa A young boy reaches for his father’s hand as refugees and asylum seekers board a bus for transfer to the Lindela Repatriation Centre. A total of 274 individuals were transferred to the immigration detention facility, according to the South African government.
Paris, France Workers stand on top of the Olympic cauldron at Tuileries Garden as the structure is dismantled and put into storage for the winter.
Banda Aceh, Indonesia A student performs the rapa’i geleng, a traditional Acehnese dance, during a cultural schools exhibition.

Gaziantep, Turkey Tomato and pepper pastes are made using traditional methods before winter. Often homemade, the pastes practically turn the city’s balconies and rooftops red as they are left to dry in the sun.
Narathiwat, Thailand Doves sit in cages during an annual bird singing competition. Entries compete for a Princess Sirindhorn royal trophy.
